title: Didn't Pre-Order an iPhone Duo Yet? Wait Times Are Significant Now
content:
iPhone Duo pre-orders began today in the U.S. and select other countries. If you have yet to place a pre-order, however, wait times at Apple are longer now.


The first customers who pre-ordered right when pre-orders began at 5 a.m. Pacific Time today will have their iPhone Duo delivered on Friday, October 23 launch day. By just 5:30 a.m. Pacific Time though, Apple's online store in the U.S. was already showing a shipping date of January 25 for all iPhone Duo configurations.

  • iPhone Duo / Star White / 256GB: January 25

  • iPhone Duo / Star White / 512GB: January 25

  • iPhone Duo / Star White / 1TB: January 25

  • iPhone Duo / Star White / 2TB: January 25

  • iPhone Duo / Night Sky / 256GB: January 25

  • iPhone Duo / Night Sky / 512GB: January 25

  • iPhone Duo / Night Sky / 1TB: January 25

  • iPhone Duo / Night Sky / 2TB: January 25
As always, Apple's shipping estimates are based on a combination of supply and demand, and we do not know how much supply was available on day one of pre-orders. Bloomberg's Mark Gurman said that iPhone Duo supply would be limited, following earlier reports of potential manufacturing challenges resulting in low production yield.

With shipping times now into 2027, the iPhone Duo is no longer available in time for delivery before Christmas through Apple's online store.

It may still be possible to secure an iPhone Duo far earlier than January by visiting an Apple Store on October 23 launch day. However, based on how quickly shipping times slipped, it seems likely that most locations will have extremely tight inventory for walk-in customers. iPhone Duo is also available at resellers like Best Buy.

Apple Store pickup was briefly an option when placing an iPhone Duo pre-order on Apple's online store, but the pickup system has now been disabled, with Apple now informing customers to check back on Saturday, October 24 for this.
